# Attributions

SwiftSelect's local image optimization uses the following open-source library alongside native browser Canvas APIs:

### UPNG.js

- **Author:** Photopea (Ivan Kuckir)
- **License**: [MIT License](https://github.com/photopea/UPNG.js/blob/master/LICENSE)
- **Source**: https://github.com/photopea/UPNG.js
- **Usage**: Fast local PNG quantization and lossless PNG optimization.

Workflow and target-size compression UX inspired by [MAZANOKE](https://github.com/civilblur/mazanoke).
